Definition: The SHA-256 of the rendered HTML bytes; the canonical evidence recorded alongside envelope-hash evidence.
Gate state set when any blocking lint finding or blocking validation diagnostic is present; the app must honor it before saving, printing, or exporting.
The print/PDF view derived from canonical HTML; explicitly NOT hash-bound evidence, carrying a banner naming the canonical SHA-256.
Invariant that software makes no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claim and requires human review.
Status enum of analysis state (model_incomplete, mechanics_solved, rule_inputs_incomplete, user_rule_checked, user_rule_failed, human_review_required).
Reference to a payload checksum with algorithm, canonicalization, payload_ref, and value.
Schema-first JSON envelope carrying model/run refs, solver version, result sets, diagnostics, provenance, reproducibility, analysis status, and rule-pack refs.
Governed result-set type vocabulary (mechanics, stress_recovery, load_vector_evidence, station_resultants, section_property_evidence, user_rule_check, diagnostic_only).
A single result value with family, object/basis refs, magnitude, unit, dimension, metadata, diagnostics, trace chain, and provenance.
Source-attribution record (source name/location/license, contributor, certification, redistribution, review, privacy).
Set of prohibited authority or reliance terms that block report sections when present in source text.
Mandatory posture that a qualified human reviewer must review software output before any reliance.
Declarative declarations of inputs a rule pack requires, checked against caller-supplied evidence to determine if a user rule check is blocked.
Record of model hash, run hashes, audit manifest ref, and deterministic ordering supporting reproducible result export.
